name: zaytoon-ai
description: Zaytoon AI Assistant — CPU-Optimized Multi-Agent System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,UI -c cyan,magenta "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\activate && python main.py" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && .venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:desktop
